university.name: Cardiff University
university.summary: Public research university in Cardiff, the capital of Wales, offering undergraduate, postgraduate taught and research degrees. International students can enter directly or through the Cardiff University International Study Centre. The university has a Country Manager for Pakistan and publishes Pakistan-specific entry guidance.
university.eligibility_note: Licensed student sponsor (gov.uk register): Cardiff University, Cardiff, Student Sponsor, Track Record, Student route.

courses.title: Computer Science
courses.overview: Three-year degree covering programming, computer systems, information systems and the mathematics used in computing, with a professional practice strand. UCAS code G400. Accredited by BCS, the Chartered Institute for IT, according to the course page.
highlights: Object Oriented Programming and Data Structures
courses.academic_requirements: A levels ABB to BBC (subject requirements apply); IB 32 to 30 overall or 655 to 554 in 3 HL subjects; GCSE Maths grade B/6 and GCSE English or Welsh grade C/4 or equivalent. Non-UK qualifications assessed against the university's equivalences.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 5.5 in each subskill; TOEFL iBT 90 (minimum 17 writing, 17 listening, 18 reading, 20 speaking); PTE Academic 69 with 59 in all communicative skills.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Cardiff's Pakistan entry requirements page states that graduates of the national high school system may be required to complete an International Foundation Year before entering undergraduate courses. No direct entry percentage for Intermediate/HSSC is published.
courses.career_notes: Typical roles named on the course page include software engineer, programmer, business analyst and systems development officer.
courses.application_deadline_note: Apply through UCAS; no deadline stated on the course page.
courses.notes: A level offer is published as a range.

courses.title: Law
courses.overview: Three-year qualifying law degree introducing the foundations of English law, including tort, criminal and public law, with optional modules on law and justice. UCAS code M100.
courses.academic_requirements: A levels AAA to ABB; IB 36 to 32 overall or 666 to 655 in 3 HL subjects; GCSE English Language grade B/6 or equivalent.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in each subskill; TOEFL iBT 90 with 20 in each subskill; PTE Academic 69 with 62 in each communicative skill.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Cardiff's Pakistan entry requirements page states that graduates of the national high school system may be required to complete an International Foundation Year before entering undergraduate courses. No direct entry percentage for Intermediate/HSSC is published.
courses.career_notes: The course page lists routes into practice as a solicitor or barrister, paralegal work, and roles in the civil service, local government and banking.
courses.application_deadline_note: Apply through UCAS; no deadline stated on the course page.
courses.notes: A level offer is published as a range.

courses.title: Business Management
courses.overview: Three-year degree at Cardiff Business School covering accounting, marketing, operations, organisational behaviour and sustainability in business. UCAS code N201.
courses.academic_requirements: A levels AAB to BBB; GCSE Maths grade B/6 (not required with A level Maths); GCSE English Language grade C/4.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 5.5 in each subskill; TOEFL iBT 90 (minimum 17 writing, 17 listening, 18 reading, 20 speaking); PTE Academic 69 with 59 in all communicative skills.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Cardiff's Pakistan entry requirements page states that graduates of the national high school system may be required to complete an International Foundation Year before entering undergraduate courses. No direct entry percentage for Intermediate/HSSC is published.
courses.career_notes: The course page reports graduates working in HR, marketing, accounting, logistics and education. No formal placement year is included.
courses.application_deadline_note: Apply through UCAS; no deadline stated on the course page.
courses.notes: A level offer is published as a range.

courses.title: Mechanical Engineering
courses.overview: Three-year engineering degree covering engineering mathematics, mechanical fundamentals and design practice. UCAS code H300. The course page states accreditation by IMechE and the Energy Institute on behalf of the Engineering Council.
courses.academic_requirements: A levels AAB to BBB including grade B in Maths; IB 34 to 31 overall or 665 to 555 in 3 HL subjects including 5 in HL Maths; GCSE English Language grade C/4.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 5.5 in each subskill; TOEFL iBT 90 (minimum 17 writing, 17 listening, 18 reading, 20 speaking); PTE Academic 69 with 59 in all communicative skills.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Cardiff's Pakistan entry requirements page states that graduates of the national high school system may be required to complete an International Foundation Year before entering undergraduate courses. No direct entry percentage for Intermediate/HSSC is published.
courses.career_notes: Graduates work in product design for the automotive, aeronautical and energy sectors, medical engineering and production management, according to the course page.
courses.uk_min_alevels: AAB to BBB including B in Maths
courses.application_deadline_note: Apply through UCAS; no deadline stated on the course page.
courses.notes: A level offer is published as a range.

courses.title: Advanced Computer Science
courses.overview: One-year taught master's for computing graduates, combining a compulsory programming paradigms module and dissertation with options in machine learning, cyber security, visual computing and the Internet of Things.
courses.academic_requirements: 2:2 honours degree in a relevant subject such as computer science, or international equivalent, with evidence of modules in programming, algorithms and data structures, mathematics and a relevant project.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.5 overall with 6.0 in every subskill, or an accepted equivalent.
courses.experience_requirements: Relevant professional experience with a signed, dated employer reference may be accepted in place of the subject module evidence.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Cardiff's Pakistan page considers a four-year bachelor's (honours) degree, a two-year master's following a two, three or four-year bachelor's, or a one-year master's following a three or four-year bachelor's. For programmes requiring a 2:2 comparable degree it states a CGPA 'in the region of 2.5 or above', decided by the admissions tutor.
courses.career_notes: The course page names systems architect, programmer and software developer roles, and progression to doctoral study.
courses.application_deadline_note: Places are allocated on a first come, first served basis; applications normally close at the end of August but may close earlier if places fill.
courses.notes: Overseas deposit of GBP 3,000 stated on the course page. Fee shown is for year one; programme lasts one year.

courses.overview: One-year master's covering statistics, machine learning, computational data science and operational research, finishing with a 60-credit dissertation that may be carried out with an external organisation.
highlights: Foundations of Operational Research and Analytics
Foundations of Statistics and Data Science
courses.academic_requirements: 2:2 honours degree in a relevant subject such as engineering, mathematics or science, or international equivalent.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.5 overall with 5.5 in each sub-skill, or an accepted equivalent.

courses.notes: Overseas deposit of GBP 3,000 stated on the course page. Fee shown is for year one; programme lasts one year.

courses.title: Finance
courses.overview: One-year master's at Cardiff Business School covering asset pricing, corporate finance, financial markets and investment, with options in fintech, sustainable finance and electronic trading.
courses.academic_requirements: 2:2 honours degree in any discipline including at least one module with mathematics, statistics or quantitative content, or international equivalent.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.5 overall with 5.5 in each subskill, or an accepted equivalent.
courses.experience_requirements: Applicants without a relevant degree may be considered on professional experience supported by signed, dated employer references.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Cardiff's Pakistan page considers a four-year bachelor's (honours) degree, a two-year master's following a two, three or four-year bachelor's, or a one-year master's following a three or four-year bachelor's. courses.title: International Journalism
courses.overview: One-year conversion master's in international news gathering, reporting and production, open to graduates of any subject, ending with a dissertation project.
courses.academic_requirements: 2:2 honours degree in any subject, or international equivalent.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.5 overall with 6.0 in all subskills, or an accepted equivalent.
courses.experience_requirements: Applicants without a degree may be considered on professional experience supported by signed, dated employer references.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Cardiff's Pakistan page considers a four-year bachelor's (honours) degree, a two-year master's following a two, three or four-year bachelor's, or a one-year master's following a three or four-year bachelor's. For programmes requiring a 2:2 comparable degree it states a CGPA 'in the region of 2.5 or above', decided by the admissions tutor.
courses.career_notes: Graduates work in international broadcast and multimedia journalism, publishing, documentary production and web content, according to the course page.
courses.application_deadline_note: Places are allocated on a first come, first served basis; applications normally close at the end of August but may close earlier if places fill.
courses.notes: Overseas deposit of GBP 3,000 stated on the course page. Fee shown is for year one; programme lasts one year.

courses.title: International Commercial Law
courses.overview: One-year master's in commercial law with a 60-credit dissertation and optional modules in areas such as international sales, world trade, arbitration, energy, investment and shipping law.
courses.academic_requirements: 2:2 honours degree in law, or international equivalent. Applicants without a relevant degree or a 2:2 may apply with further evidence such as a CV and references.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.5 overall with 6.0 in all subskills, or an accepted equivalent.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Cardiff's Pakistan page considers a four-year bachelor's (honours) degree, a two-year master's following a two, three or four-year bachelor's, or a one-year master's following a three or four-year bachelor's. For programmes requiring a 2:2 comparable degree it states a CGPA 'in the region of 2.5 or above', decided by the admissions tutor.
courses.career_notes: The course page names careers in trade, finance, insurance and dispute settlement, and progression to PhD study.
courses.application_deadline_note: Places are allocated on a first come, first served basis; applications normally close at the end of August but may close earlier if places fill.
courses.notes: The course page states the programme is under review and details are indicative and subject to change. Overseas deposit of GBP 3,000 stated on the course page. Fee shown is for year one; programme lasts one year.

courses.title: International Foundation Year: Engineering, Science and Computing
courses.award: International Foundation Year (progression to Cardiff University undergraduate degrees)
courses.overview: Two-semester pathway taught on the Cardiff campus at the Cardiff University International Study Centre, combining academic English with subject modules, for students who need preparation before entering a Cardiff undergraduate degree.
highlights: Subject modules for engineering, science and computing degrees
courses.academic_requirements: Good high school graduation grades or equivalent; IB 24 points. Pakistan: Year 11 with 75% overall (50% in relevant subjects, 4 or more passes) or HSC (Year 12) with 60% overall and at least 50% in any subject. Age 17 or over.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS Academic for UKVI 5.0 overall with at least 5.0 in writing and no other skill below 4.0 (higher for Medicine, Dental Surgery, Pharmacy, Optometry and some media degrees).
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Cardiff University International Study Centre lists for Pakistan: Year 11 with 75% overall, or HSC (Year 12) with 60% overall and at least 50% in any subject.
courses.notes: Target year fee not yet published; GBP 24,500 is the 2026/27 fee for this route (other routes: Business, Finance and Management GBP 23,250; Health and Life Sciences GBP 25,250; Law, Social Sciences and Humanities GBP 22,250). Fee page does not state whether this is the full programme fee. Centre site is maintained by Study Group. Deposits: GBP 1,000 security deposit, GBP 260 administration fee, GBP 6,000 advance tuition before CAS. Exact start dates not opened; January entry listed but not for Medicine or Dental Surgery progression.

scholarships.name: Vice-Chancellor's Undergraduate International Scholarship
scholarships.value_text: GBP 5,000 tuition fee discount for applicants domiciled in Pakistan (standard award GBP 3,500)
scholarships.summary: Automatic tuition fee discount for overseas fee-paying undergraduate applicants who meet the published entry requirements exactly. Pakistan-domiciled applicants receive the higher GBP 5,000 rate.
scholarships.criteria_text: Overseas fee status; meet published minimum entry requirements exactly; apply by 30 June 2027, make Cardiff firm choice, meet all conditions by 31 August 2027. Dentistry, Medicine and Healthcare programmes and certificate/diploma awards excluded.
scholarships.deadline_note: Apply to the University by 30 June 2027 and meet all offer conditions, including English, by 31 August 2027.
scholarships.notes: Page does not state whether the discount applies to the first year only or to each year; value_basis left null.

scholarships.name: Undergraduate International Excellence Scholarship
scholarships.summary: Competitive award for self-financed international undergraduates holding an offer; eligible applicants are invited by email to submit a short written application. Nine awards are stated for 2027.
scholarships.criteria_text: International fee status; self-financed; hold an offer and meet the original published admissions criteria. Dentistry, Medicine and Healthcare programmes excluded.
scholarships.deadline_note: Application deadline 23:59 on 2 April 2027; offer conditions to be met by 31 August 2027.
scholarships.notes: Page is internally inconsistent: application section refers to autumn 2027 entry, eligibility section to autumn 2026. Payment basis not stated.

scholarships.name: International Study Centre Undergraduate Progression Scholarship
scholarships.value_text: GBP 2,000 per year, or GBP 3,000 per year with 75% or higher in the IFY (70% or higher in International Year One), for up to four years
scholarships.summary: Automatic tuition discount for self-financed international students who complete a Cardiff University International Study Centre programme in 2026/27 and progress to an eligible Cardiff undergraduate degree in September 2027.
scholarships.criteria_text: Complete IFY or IY1 at the ISC in 2026/27; international fee status; self-financed; meet Cardiff offer conditions by 6 September 2027. Dentistry, Medicine and Healthcare programmes and repeat years excluded.
scholarships.deadline_note: Meet the conditions of the Cardiff University offer by 6 September 2027.
scholarships.notes: value_amount records the base award; the higher GBP 3,000 rate depends on pathway grade.

scholarships.name: Vice-Chancellor's Postgraduate International Scholarship
scholarships.value_text: GBP 6,000 tuition fee discount for applicants domiciled in Pakistan (standard award GBP 4,000)
scholarships.summary: Automatic tuition fee discount on selected taught master's programmes for applicants who meet published entry requirements exactly and accept their offer and pay any deposit. Pakistan-domiciled applicants receive GBP 6,000.
scholarships.criteria_text: Meet published minimum entry requirements exactly; accept an offer on a selected programme and pay any required deposit by the date in the offer letter.
scholarships.deadline_note: Deposit deadline as stated in the offer letter; intake-specific terms not opened.
scholarships.notes: Current terms cover September 2026 and January 2027 entry only; September 2027 terms not yet published. Eligible programme list not opened.

scholarships.name: Cardiff Business School 125th Anniversary Scholarship
scholarships.summary: Award for international students joining an eligible full-time MSc at Cardiff Business School, with automatic consideration.
scholarships.criteria_text: International students joining an eligible Cardiff Business School MSc; eligible programme list in the terms and conditions.
scholarships.deadline_note: Deadline for the January 2027 intake is 4 December 2026 (September 2026 intake closed 31 July 2026).
scholarships.notes: Payment method, eligible programmes and offer requirement not stated on the page. No September 2027 round published.

scholarships.name: MBA Public Value Scholarship
scholarships.value_text: GBP 10,000 automatic tuition fee discount (split across two years for part-time study)
scholarships.summary: Automatic tuition fee discount for applicants who meet the terms of their offer and enrol on a Cardiff MBA programme, full-time or part-time.
scholarships.criteria_text: Meet offer terms and enrol on any Cardiff University MBA programme; recipients of other funding of this kind are not eligible. Autumn semester entry.
scholarships.deadline_note: No deadline stated on the page.
scholarships.notes: Page names no academic year; fee status eligibility not stated. International students should not rely on it for UKVI financial requirements.

scholarships.name: Alumni Discount
scholarships.summary: Automatic tuition reduction for Cardiff University graduates progressing to an eligible taught master's programme at a higher level than their existing qualification.
scholarships.criteria_text: Cardiff graduate with a credit-bearing qualification; self-funded; eligible full-time or part-time taught master's. For international students, combined value with university scholarships capped at GBP 5,000. Distance learning, PgDip, PgCert and some clinical courses excluded.
scholarships.notes: Page text refers to 2026/27 study while metadata refers to 2025/26; 2027/28 terms not yet confirmed.

scholarships.name: UK Research and Innovation Studentships (international)
scholarships.value_text: Fully funded: UKRI covers UK fees and Cardiff covers the difference to the international fee; studentships typically include a stipend
scholarships.summary: Doctoral studentships funded through UKRI training partnerships, where Cardiff covers the international fee difference so successful international candidates are fully funded. Up to 30% of each intake can be international.
scholarships.criteria_text: Successful applicant to an advertised UKRI-funded studentship; up to 30% of each intake can be international studentships.
scholarships.deadline_note: Recruitment mostly happens 9 to 12 months before the start date; studentships typically start in October.
scholarships.notes: Stipend amount and specific studentships not stated on the page; candidates search the PhD studentships listing.
